description: Header file defining the SerialDriver class for Bluetooth HCI communication over serial ports, including request/response structures, ioctl command definitions, and serial port configuration methods.

classes.name: SerialDriver
classes.description: Manages serial port communication for Bluetooth HCI, including setup, exchange, and reconfiguration.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Configures the serial port with specified flags and protocol.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs data exchange over the serial port with specified request and response objects.

methods.name: Reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the serial port with a new baud rate.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Virtual method called when data is received; meant to be overridden.
